bacterial_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked angular leaf spots bounded by leaf veins; black lesions on stems ('blackarm') and boll rot.

organic_measures.name: Copper Hydroxide Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray copper hydroxide (2 g/L) combined with neem leaf extract.

chemical_measures.name: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride 50% WP
chemical_measures.dosage: 0.1 g Streptocycline + 2.5 g COC per liter
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Follow regulatory guidelines for antibiotic agricultural sprays.

prevention_measures: Delint seed with concentrated sulfuric acid before sowing.
sources: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Advisory

curl_virus.pathogen: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (Begomovirus / Whitefly Vector)
curl_virus.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, thickened veins, enations (leaf-like outgrowths) on leaf undersides, severe stunting.

organic_measures.name: Whitefly Vector Management
organic_measures.method: Install yellow sticky traps (20 traps/acre). Spray neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or fish oil rosin soap.

chemical_measures.name: Diafenthiuron 50% WP or Afidopyropen 50 g/L DC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Avoid spraying when beneficial predators (lacewings, ladybugs) are abundant.

prevention_measures: Plant CLCuV-tolerant hybrids recommended for the region.
Eradicate weed hosts (e.g. Abutilon, Xanthium) along field margins.

fusarium_wilt.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum (Soil-borne Fungal)
fusarium_wilt.symptoms: Yellowing and browning of leaf margins, drooping leaves, brown to black vascular discoloration inside lower stem tissue.

organic_measures.name: Trichoderma harzianum Soil Application
organic_measures.method: Enrich 250 kg FYM with 2.5 kg Trichoderma harzianum per acre and apply to soil at planting.

chemical_measures.name: Carbendazim 50% WP Soil Drench
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Do not drench near open water bodies.

prevention_measures: Rotate with non-host crops like sorghum or maize for 3 years.
Apply neem cake to soil (250 kg/ha).

cotton_healthy.symptoms: Deep green palmate leaves, erect main stem, clean squares and bolls without spots or curling.

organic_measures.name: Pheromone Trap & Foliar Nutrition
organic_measures.method: Install pink bollworm pheromone traps (4 traps/acre). Spray 1% potassium nitrate for boll development.

prevention_measures: Maintain adequate soil irrigation during boll formation.
